# Server Rules
0. Admins have the authority to interpret the rules in what way they see fit and ensure the round goes smoothly and is fun for everyone, as such all admins have the final say and authority over the rules
1. This server has a bit of a heavy focus on improvised roleplay and having a very lax "yes and" approach to how things go in the rounds, roleplay in whatever way you want and do funny gimmicks and so on, as long as it doesn't conflict and goes against the other few rules
